notes.title: Challenge Other Couriers in Knockout Mode
notes.content:
Hello Bicycle Courier!


Do you want to test your bicycle couriering skills against others? See who can scour the streets of New Island the fastest and deliver parcels quickly (and "safely” is also desirable, but not a necessity.) 


Then good news. You can! 


Open your phone and select the Strift app to see other players time trials across the eight different zones. Challenge yourself to climb the leaderboards and beat your friends. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238128/5b0301ac85fd5cee06443a1cdd5bd73220001d31.png[/img]

Speaking of friends, why not head to The Hub and join them for a ‘friendly’ game of Knockout? Compete with up to five other couriers – across all platforms – to deliver packages the fastest around your zone of choice. 


Each round, the slowest rider will face their customer’s wrath and be eliminated, while everyone else gets more hard-earned cash*. Sweet, right? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238128/bfb6914eacb34d2c6b9e1a932b699f512adfe157.gif[/img]

Speaking of cash, you need a way to spend it. Inside the darkened corridors of The Hub, you can find the handy workshop ‘Bikey Boys’ to customise your bike to ride in style. 

From changing colours to fitting new parts, you can do it all. Unlock new driveshafts, wheels, handles, and more as you progress through your global delivery domination. Purchase them at Bikey Boys, or through their nifty phone app.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238128/58fb6d105018a52ac51f9ac7e8638663d48f9d3a.gif[/img]

Change a spoke before you go broke!


* after taxes, deductions, and running costs.

notes.title: Performance Patch Out Now
notes.content:
Hello Bicycle Courier! 

 

We know a thing about false starts, but we’re committed to delivering the best satirical bicycle game in the world.  

 
[previewyoutube=1ZiONfUub-s;full][/previewyoutube]
 

Today’s new patch focuses on bike tuning to remove more pesky bugs and adding more performance settings for your cycling pleasure. 

It’s smoother! It’s faster! It’s funnier*! Features include: 

[list]
[*] [b]Further performance settings including the ability to use FSR 3.0 or DLSS upscaling 

[*] Achievement bug fixes, all achievements are now obtainable 

[*] Multiple progress blocking bugs resolved 

[*] Improved keyboard remapping UI 

[*] Further environment optimisations and pop-in reduction [/b]
[/list]

 

Update now, patch up that flat, and get delivering those parcels. 

[i](*Note: humour content does not change, all new jokes exist with our new trailer.)

notes.title: Performance update
notes.content:
Hi folks, thanks for your patience, it's fair to say that our Steam launch didn't exactly go off without a hitch! But, I'm happy to say this new patch addresses many of the issues folks encountered on launch day. We intend to support Parcel Corps for a long time to come so keep checking back, more improvements and extra content are in the works. Keep an eye on the discussion forum and thank you again for your patience. I hope you enjoy our game.
[i]Will Barr, Parcel Corps Game Director[/i]

[b]Patch Notes - v98.9[/b]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] “Contacts” character selection app not swapping player character
[*] Location icons not selectable in Delivery Rush
[*] Missions not removing custom drop-offs when completed
[*] Items awarded by businesses unlock in Bike Shop app correctly
[*] Grind rails disappearing in Parklands level
[*] Control not returned to player after “Resistance” mission briefing cutscene
[*] PlayStation type controller sprites added
[/list]

Improvements:
[list]
[*] Various cutscene animations updated
[*] Performance improvements
[*] In-game progression now more robust
[*] Additional graphics options:
[list]
[*] Full Screen - a toggle cycle between Fullscreen and Windowed modes
[*] MSAA - can set anti-aliasing to values 2x, 4x, 8x, OFF
[*] Texture Quality - can set the texture levels in-game to values Low, Medium, High
[*] Motion Blur - a toggle to cycle ON or OFF
(This is in addition to the Resolution and VSync settings already present.)
[/list]

notes.title: These Businesses Need Your Service!
notes.content:
Hello future bicycle couriers! 

 

Whether you’re delivering for Das La Post or wheelie-ing with the Wallaby Wheelers, your objective is the same – to get as many businesses as possible around New Island to sign up for your services! 

 

Some of these business owners run small, humble services. Others more... eccentric ventures. Here are three business owners you will meet on your quest for delivery domination! 

 

[h3][b]Brawn’s Gym [/b][/h3]

 

[i][b]“Feel the burn, Bicycle Courier.” [/b][/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238128/6d47d90bcd4025f815621a33970b54d423d4e12a.png[/img]

Brawn, also known as “Bullchad”, is a muscular bodybuilder and gym instructor. He loves to lift, and attributes it to four of his five steps to get fit (alongside a certain enhancement substance).  

 

He needs someone to deliver a new supply of beef-flavoured energy supplements to his clients, as doing any kind of cardio would ruin his physique. Prove yourself by charging through the streets of the Parklands, following checkpoints like a bull to a red rag.  

 

You might just gain his approval and business if you do it quick enough. 

 

[h3][b]Ring’Os[/b][/h3]

 

[i][b]“We’re bringing good vibes, sugar glaze and rainbow sprinkles right into your esophagus.” [/b][/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238128/f56537cd65ca6c820e2201b1cefe1b9ab91b4678.png[/img]

Delivering for Ring’Os is sure to leave you doing doughnuts through New Island. With multiple happy customers and clientele, Ring’Os is booming – allowing for plenty of gigs for bicycle couriers. 

 

Feel the groove as you deliver these tasty treats in a timely manner. You may even get tasked with ‘mixing them up’ on route! 

 

[h3][b]Petal Pusher [/b][/h3]

 

[i][b]“We don’t sell Gas Flowers.” [/b][/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238128/8f0f285eddf97d9a03d71c9e55f9ac6a1f221011.png[/img]

Selling only the highest quality flowers, this solo entrepreneur has made her living by perfecting her patented compost recipe. The soil only has one side effect – the high potency of its fumes! 

 

When delivering to customers, one must not only handle the package with care to avoid spillages but needs to remain agile and always on the move. Failure to do so, and you may just wake up somewhere unfamiliar... 

 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2015960/Parcel_Corps/ 

 

These are just three of the businesses that require the services of [b]YOU![/b] Ride well, digital bicycle courier.
